footprint.nexusIdNote: the provider mod folder has no readable meta.ini

limits: Local world-record contributors only; asset-only replacers and runtime-created placements are outside this map.

A location lists only evidence indexed to that cell or grid coordinate. A WRLD parent-field change (climate, water, flags, ...) applies to the whole worldspace and is listed under worldspaceWide, not at each location. Rebuildable OFST data, WorldChildren group metadata, record-header version bookkeeping (VCS1, VCS2, form version) and unchanged containers are excluded.

Large-reference rows and MaxHeight entries are compared only at measured grid coordinates; a change to the same table elsewhere adds no local contributor, and a MaxHeight table added or removed as a whole is worldspace-wide.

nearby.note: a plugin listed here carries a CELL record within the ring of an exterior footprint cell, outside the footprint itself; persistent references placed into the ring are not read, and alsoScanned plugins were read for CELL records only.

expansion.note: outbound form links are counted per target under its footprint's linksByMaster; a link into the target's own ModKey is internal and counted there too.

unmeasured.why: a Papyrus script can place, move or delete references at runtime; this probe reads records only, so the placement footprint omits anything a script puts there.
a quest alias resolves to a reference chosen at runtime, so the actor or object a quest actually moves is not in this footprint.
a *_SWAP.ini replaces a reference's base object at load; the record types and model paths counted here are the RECORD's, not the swapped base's.

a mod that only ships meshes or textures has no records to enumerate and so no footprint here, though it changes what the game draws; model paths are read off records and never resolved against the VFS.
LOD, occlusion and patcher output generated from an earlier placement is not read, so whether any of it is now stale is outside this measurement.

limits: model paths are read off records and never resolved against the asset view, so a path inside a BSA and a path that exists nowhere read alike here.
nexusId is MO2's cached meta.ini value; a hand-installed, merged or FOMOD-built mod folder has none, and its absence is not evidence that the mod is not on Nexus.

the record enumeration is Mutagen's, so a record type Mutagen does not model is absent from recordTypes rather than reported as unknown; signatureUnresolved counts the types whose signature would not resolve.

unknown.installerChoices: not modelled: MO2 keeps no per-mod record of the FOMOD options taken; the installed files are the evidence
unknown.gameBuild: not read: the executable version and SKSE/plugin set are not part of a records run
unknown.distributors: not read: SPID / KID / SkyPatcher layers are not scanned; only BOS ini files are listed as overlays
unknown.saveState: not applicable: a records run judges a fresh load, never a save
